title: Prostate Cancer
subtitle: StewardMD ONCOTREE navigator (draft)
provenanceNote: ONCOTREE navigator DRAFT for prostate cancer. Captures disease state (localized on androgen-deprivation with radiation; metastatic castration-sensitive; metastatic castration-resistant) and, in mCRPC, the biomarker-directed option (HRR/BRCA -> PARP inhibitor; PSMA-positive -> radioligand therapy; standard ARPI/taxane). Routes to APPLICABLE existing StewardMD Standard Protocols by reference. The prostate protocols use free-text stage/setting labels, so the per-node protocolRefs are the authoritative scope. Invents no dose/regimen/criterion. Structural pathway consistent with Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Prostate Cancer; no proprietary content reproduced. DRAFT - not clinically activated; physician decides.
sourceNote: Structural pathway consistent with Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Prostate Cancer. Options reference existing StewardMD Standard Protocols and their own evidence layers.

nodes.name: Disease state
nodes.title: Disease state
nodes.description: Prostate cancer therapy is defined by disease state: localized (with radiation), metastatic castration-sensitive (mCSPC), or metastatic castration-resistant (mCRPC).

nodes.name: mCRPC option
nodes.title: mCRPC: treatment consideration
nodes.description: In mCRPC, select the relevant consideration: standard androgen-receptor pathway inhibitor / taxane, or a biomarker-directed option (HRR/BRCA mutation for a PARP inhibitor; PSMA-positive imaging for radioligand therapy).

nodes.name: Localized prostate
nodes.title: Localized / regional: androgen-deprivation therapy
nodes.description: Androgen-deprivation therapy combined with radiation for localized/regional disease. Physician selects.

nodes.name: mCSPC
nodes.title: mCSPC: ADT intensification
nodes.description: Metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer - androgen-deprivation therapy intensified with an androgen-receptor pathway inhibitor or docetaxel. Physician selects.

nodes.name: mCRPC standard
nodes.title: mCRPC: standard ARPI / taxane
nodes.description: Metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer - androgen-receptor pathway inhibitor (abiraterone/enzalutamide) or taxane chemotherapy (docetaxel, then cabazitaxel). Physician selects.

nodes.name: mCRPC PARP
nodes.title: mCRPC, HRR/BRCA: PARP inhibitor
nodes.description: mCRPC with a homologous-recombination-repair (HRR) or BRCA alteration - a PARP inhibitor (olaparib). Physician selects.

nodes.name: mCRPC radioligand
nodes.title: mCRPC, PSMA-positive: radioligand therapy
nodes.description: mCRPC with PSMA-positive imaging - Lu-177-PSMA radioligand therapy. Physician selects.
